title: 玻璃材质重塑（JSON）
content: 基于以下 JSON 美学定义，将一把撑开的老虎伞重新渲染为玻璃材质：{ "style": "photorealistic 3D render", "material": "translucent colored glass", "object": "a classic open umbrella with tiger-orange panels", "background": "plain white", "lighting": "soft, diffused studio lighting", "camera": "centered, slight top-down" }。玻璃需带彩虹色折射，伞骨为金属银色，整体干净通透，细节精致。
